background_semantics: warmed request within 30s recent-IP coalescing interval; prior background tasks completed, no task spawned during measured handler; cold/periodic background SQL not included
boundary: one in-process AuthorizeHttp complete Rust handler in PreflightAndVerify mode; excludes Go, transport, admission/send queues, and separate Inspect RPC

templates.sql_template: SELECT aggregate_json FROM mobility_session_aggregates WHERE session_id = ?1

SELECT strings.value FROM kv_strings AS strings JOIN kv_keys AS keys ON keys.key = strings.key WHERE strings.key = ?1 AND keys.kind = 'string' AND (keys.expires_at_ms IS NULL OR keys.expires_at_ms > ?2)
SELECT strings.value, keys.expires_at_ms FROM kv_strings AS strings JOIN kv_keys AS keys ON keys.key = strings.key WHERE strings.key = ?1 AND (keys.expires_at_ms IS NULL OR keys.expires_at_ms > ?2)
SELECT document_json, host_mappings_generation, revision FROM config_documents WHERE singleton = 1
SELECT kind FROM kv_keys WHERE key = ?1
SELECT value FROM kv_strings WHERE key = ?1
DELETE FROM kv_keys WHERE key = ?1 AND expires_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND expires_at_ms <= ?2

SELECT active.member, active.score, strings.value, grant_keys.expires_at_ms FROM kv_zset AS active LEFT JOIN kv_keys AS grant_keys ON grant_keys.key = active.member AND grant_keys.kind = 'string' LEFT JOIN kv_strings AS strings ON strings.key = grant_keys.key WHERE active.key = ?1 ORDER BY active.member
SELECT grant_digest, expires_at_score FROM subdomain_rule_grant_active_entries WHERE host_digest = ?1 ORDER BY grant_digest
SELECT host, policy_version, group_id, issued_at, last_access_at, hard_expires_at, expires_at_ms FROM subdomain_rule_grants WHERE grant_digest = ?1
